Class AccountSelector

public inherited sharing class AccountSelector

Selector class for the Account object. Provides centralized query methods for retrieving account data including venue details, vendor details, contact relations, billing accounts, and account ownership information.

Group:
    Selector Classes

Since:
    05/31/2021

Version:
    1.10
